_comment: Project fidelity config for the SPX mobile 消费卡账户 (Cards) screen. Same tolerances/gate as the auth screens.
_checkTextContainerStyleNote: Opt-in: for each TEXT match, also compare the nearest styled-ancestor's bg/border (both sides). Catches non-text container chrome defects (selected pill's missing gold fill, card's missing 1px stroke) that the text-anchored diff is structurally blind to. Skill change landed 2026-05-28; auth/home don't opt in yet so they're unaffected.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC' (Traditional). The app correctly ships 'HarmonyOS Sans SC' (Simplified) for its zh_CN UI — same Huawei type family, correct script variant. Latin labels use the bundled PlusJakartaSans-*. These aliases let the diff accept the app's correct font without a per-node deviation.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock (9:41 + signal/wifi/battery) is device chrome (topInset reserves the band). 存款/转账 are invisible leftover layers inside the Quick-Action component master (986:18580 y546 / 958:12989 y725) — they render at 0 opacity / behind the live labels (划转/持卡人信息/查看详细信息/调整单笔限额) and never appear in the exported raster, so they are dropped to avoid phantom MISSING criticals.

deviations.reason: Bottom-nav active-weight follows the design-system rule (active 500 / inactive 400). The Cards master frame left 首页 at 500 — a copy-paste leftover from the Home frame where 首页 was the active tab. On the Cards screen 消费 is active, so impl renders 首页=400. Approved 2026-05-28.
Bottom-nav active tab on the Cards screen is 消费 → weight 500 per the design-system rule; the Cards master frame mislabeled it 400 (copy leftover). impl is correct. Approved 2026-05-28.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / (Arrows|Users) / (Arrow Right|Arrow Down|User Circle)$
iconDeviations.reason: Still-font-glyph functional/nav icons: transaction-row directional chevrons (arrow-down-left/up-right) + view-all Arrow Right + bottom-nav 消费 (User Circle). App-wide @expo/vector-icons; geometry/box still token-checked, only vector-path-set identity waived. The quick-function icons 划转/持卡人信息/查看详细信息/调整单笔限额 are NO LONGER here — they were migrated to real Figma SVGs (RefreshMark/UserIdMark/DocumentTextMark/TuningSquareMark) and now pass natively. Approved 2026-05-28.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Arrows / Refresh$
iconDeviations.reason: 划转 renders the real Figma Refresh SVG (RefreshMark, fill-based, verified visually in the impl crop). icon-diff's nearest-center match misassigns the rendered <svg> under the topInset offset and reports impl=0 here — a matcher artifact, NOT a missing/wrong icon. Waived until the icon-diff offset matching is hardened. Approved 2026-05-28.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner iris sub-node of the balance eye (Figma exports the eye as outer-stroke + iris as two icon nodes). The impl renders the whole eye as one combined EyeMark SVG, so the iris is not a separate <svg>. The eye glyph itself now uses the authoritative EyeMark SVG (react-native-svg) and is gated normally. Approved 2026-05-28.

_iconDeviationsNote: Read by icon-diff.mjs: a matched icon's fail/warn is downgraded to `waive` (info) and excluded from `fails`, so a documented, intentional substitution doesn't permanently red-gate the screen. The eye is deliberately NOT listed — it is a real fix (Feather glyph -> EyeMark SVG), so it must pass on its own.

ux._motionNote: mismatch/required are error subtypes → they animate on the field's error transition (errorDurationMs 200 / ease-in-out), same as `error`. Without these the diff would compare them to the 150ms default and flag a phantom motion-minor.
